package repository

import (
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
)

// CourseRepository describes storage for courses.
type CourseRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, course domain.Course) error
	GetBySlug(ctx Context, slug string) (*domain.Course, error)
	GetByID(ctx Context, id string) (*domain.Course, error)
	GetByIDWithFields(ctx Context, id string, f queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error)
	Update(ctx Context, course domain.Course) error
	Delete(ctx Context, courseID string) error
	List(ctx Context, lang string, filters filters.CourseFilters, sort *filters.SortOptions) ([]domain.CoursePreview, error)
	ListFields(ctx Context, lang string, f queryfields.Set, filters filters.CourseFilters, sort *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error)
}

// CatalogScopeRepository lists public track-level paths that contain at least
// one visible active course through an entirely active catalog hierarchy.
type CatalogScopeRepository interface {
	ListPublic(ctx Context, lang string) ([]domain.CatalogScope, error)
}

// CourseOutlineRepository loads the lightweight ordered hierarchy for one
// visible active course.
type CourseOutlineRepository interface {
	GetPublic(ctx Context, courseID string, lang string) (*domain.CourseOutline, error)
}

// ContentAccessRepository resolves student-facing access without exposing a
// hidden Course hierarchy. Relation checks deliberately require the source
// material to belong to a visible active Course and the target to belong to an
// active Course (which may itself be hidden from the catalog).
type ContentAccessRepository interface {
	CanViewCourse(ctx Context, courseID string) (bool, error)
	CanViewModule(ctx Context, moduleID string) (bool, error)
	CanViewSection(ctx Context, sectionID string) (bool, error)
	CanViewLesson(ctx Context, lessonID string) (bool, error)
	CanViewTask(ctx Context, taskID string) (bool, error)
	CanViewExample(ctx Context, exampleID string) (bool, error)
	CanViewLessonViaRelation(ctx Context, lessonID string, relationID string) (bool, error)
	CanViewTaskViaRelation(ctx Context, taskID string, relationID string) (bool, error)
	CanViewExampleViaRelation(ctx Context, exampleID string, relationID string) (bool, error)
}

// LessonReadAccessRepository resolves inherited lesson-reading policy for one
// or more lessons. includeHiddenCourses is used only after an exact semantic
// relation has already authorized navigation to content in a hidden course.
type LessonReadAccessRepository interface {
	ResolveLessonReadAccess(ctx Context, lessonIDs []string, includeHiddenCourses bool) (map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution, error)
}

// CourseLessonReadAccessRepository resolves inherited reading policy only
// through placements belonging to the requested visible course.
type CourseLessonReadAccessRepository interface {
	ResolveCourseLessonReadAccess(ctx Context, courseID string, lessonIDs []string) (map[string]domain.LessonReadAccessResolution, error)
}

// TechVersionRepository describes storage for tech versions.
type TechVersionRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, version domain.TechVersion) error
	GetByID(ctx Context, id int) (*domain.TechVersion, error)
	GetByTechAndVersion(ctx Context, techID int, version string) (*domain.TechVersion, error)
	Update(ctx Context, version domain.TechVersion) error
	Delete(ctx Context, id int) error
	List(ctx Context, filters filters.TechVersionFilters) ([]domain.TechVersion, int, error)
}

// TechRepository describes storage for tech labels.
type TechRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, tech domain.Tech) error
	GetByLabel(ctx Context, label string) (*domain.Tech, error)
	GetByID(ctx Context, id int) (*domain.Tech, error)
	Update(ctx Context, tech domain.Tech) error
	Delete(ctx Context, id int) error
	List(ctx Context, filters filters.TechFilters) ([]domain.Tech, int, error)
}

// TagRepository describes storage for tags.
type TagRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, tag domain.Tag) error
	GetByID(ctx Context, id int) (*domain.Tag, error)
	GetBySlug(ctx Context, slug string) (*domain.Tag, error)
	Update(ctx Context, tag domain.Tag) error
	Delete(ctx Context, id int) error
	List(ctx Context, filters filters.TagFilters) ([]domain.Tag, int, error)
}

// PositionRepository describes storage for positions.
type PositionRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, position domain.Position) error
	GetByID(ctx Context, id int) (*domain.Position, error)
	GetByName(ctx Context, name string) (*domain.Position, error)
	Update(ctx Context, position domain.Position) error
	Delete(ctx Context, id int) error
	List(ctx Context, filters filters.PositionFilters) ([]domain.Position, int, error)
}

// ComposeConfigRepository describes storage for compose configs.
type ComposeConfigRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, cfg domain.ComposeConfig) error
	GetByID(ctx Context, id string) (*domain.ComposeConfig, error)
	GetByConfig(ctx Context, config []byte) (*domain.ComposeConfig, error)
	Update(ctx Context, cfg domain.ComposeConfig) error
	List(ctx Context, filters filters.ComposeConfigFilters) ([]domain.ComposeConfig, int, error)
	Delete(ctx Context, id string) error
}

// CourseI18nRepository describes storage for course localizations.
type CourseI18nRepository interface {
	Upsert(ctx Context, entry domain.CourseI18n) error
	GetByCourseAndLang(ctx Context, courseID string, lang string) (*domain.CourseI18n, error)
	ListByCourse(ctx Context, courseID string) ([]domain.CourseI18n, error)
	CountByCourse(ctx Context, courseID string) (int, error)
	DeleteByCourse(ctx Context, courseID string, i18nID int) error
}

// ModuleRepository describes storage for modules.
type ModuleRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, module domain.Module) error
	Get(ctx Context, id string) (*domain.Module, error)
	Update(ctx Context, module domain.Module) error
	Delete(ctx Context, id string) error
	List(ctx Context, filters filters.ModuleFilters) ([]domain.Module, error)
	ListAll(ctx Context) ([]domain.Module, error)
	ListIndependent(ctx Context) ([]domain.Module, error)
	ListByCourse(ctx Context, courseID string) ([]domain.Module, error)
}

// ModuleI18nRepository describes storage for module localizations.
type ModuleI18nRepository interface {
	Upsert(ctx Context, entry domain.ModuleI18n) error
	ListByModule(ctx Context, moduleID string) ([]domain.ModuleI18n, error)
	Delete(ctx Context, moduleID string, i18nID int) error
}

// SectionRepository describes storage for sections.
type SectionRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, section domain.Section) error
	Get(ctx Context, id string) (*domain.Section, error)
	Update(ctx Context, section domain.Section) error
	Delete(ctx Context, id string) error
	ListAll(ctx Context) ([]domain.Section, error)
	ListByModule(ctx Context, moduleID string) ([]domain.Section, error)
}

// SectionI18nRepository describes storage for section localizations.
type SectionI18nRepository interface {
	Upsert(ctx Context, entry domain.SectionI18n) error
	ListBySection(ctx Context, sectionID string) ([]domain.SectionI18n, error)
	Delete(ctx Context, sectionID string, i18nID int) error
}

// CourseModuleRepository describes storage for course-module links.
type CourseModuleRepository interface {
	ReplaceByCourse(ctx Context, courseID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error
	Add(ctx Context, courseID string, moduleID string, order int) error
	Delete(ctx Context, courseID string, moduleID string) error
}

// ModuleSectionRepository describes storage for module-section links.
type ModuleSectionRepository interface {
	ReplaceByModule(ctx Context, moduleID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error
	Add(ctx Context, moduleID string, sectionID string, order int) error
	Delete(ctx Context, moduleID string, sectionID string) error
}

// CourseTechRepository describes storage for course-tech links.
type CourseTechRepository interface {
	Add(ctx Context, courseID string, techID int) error
	Replace(ctx Context, courseID string, techIDs []int) error
}

// PositionTechRepository describes storage for position-tech links.
type PositionTechRepository interface {
	Replace(ctx Context, positionID int, techIDs []int) error
	ListTechs(ctx Context, positionID int) ([]domain.Tech, error)
}

// ComposeConfigTechRepository describes storage for compose_config-tech links.
type ComposeConfigTechRepository interface {
	Add(ctx Context, composeConfigID string, techID int) error
	Replace(ctx Context, composeConfigID string, techIDs []int) error
	ListTechIDs(ctx Context, composeConfigID string) ([]int, error)
}

// I18nRepository describes storage for i18n entries.
type I18nRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, entry domain.I18n) error
	GetByID(ctx Context, id int) (*domain.I18n, error)
	GetByLanguage(ctx Context, language string) (*domain.I18n, error)
	List(ctx Context) ([]domain.I18n, error)
}

// CourseTagRepository describes storage for course-tag links.
type CourseTagRepository interface {
	Replace(ctx Context, courseID string, tagIDs []int) error
}

// PositionCourseRepository describes storage for position-course links.
type PositionCourseRepository interface {
	Replace(ctx Context, positionID int, courseIDs []string) error
	ListCourses(ctx Context, positionID int, lang string, onlyActive bool) ([]domain.CoursePreview, error)
}

// TrackRepository describes storage for top-level learning tracks.
type TrackRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, track domain.Track) error
	Get(ctx Context, id string) (*domain.Track, error)
	GetBySourceKey(ctx Context, sourceKey string) (*domain.Track, error)
	Update(ctx Context, track domain.Track) error
	Delete(ctx Context, id string) error
	List(ctx Context, filters filters.TrackFilters) ([]domain.Track, error)
}

// TrackI18nRepository describes storage for track localizations.
type TrackI18nRepository interface {
	Upsert(ctx Context, entry domain.TrackI18n) error
	ListByTrack(ctx Context, trackID string) ([]domain.TrackI18n, error)
	Delete(ctx Context, trackID string, i18nID int) error
}

// CourseLevelRepository describes storage for course levels.
type CourseLevelRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, level domain.CourseLevel) error
	Get(ctx Context, id string) (*domain.CourseLevel, error)
	GetBySourceKey(ctx Context, sourceKey string) (*domain.CourseLevel, error)
	Update(ctx Context, level domain.CourseLevel) error
	Delete(ctx Context, id string) error
	List(ctx Context, filters filters.CourseLevelFilters) ([]domain.CourseLevel, error)

type CourseLevelI18nRepository interface {
	Upsert(ctx Context, entry domain.CourseLevelI18n) error
	ListByLevel(ctx Context, levelID string) ([]domain.CourseLevelI18n, error)
	Delete(ctx Context, levelID string, i18nID int) error
}

// CourseGroupRepository describes storage for course groups.
type CourseGroupRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, group domain.CourseGroup) error
	Get(ctx Context, id string) (*domain.CourseGroup, error)
	GetBySourceKey(ctx Context, sourceKey string) (*domain.CourseGroup, error)
	Update(ctx Context, group domain.CourseGroup) error
	Delete(ctx Context, id string) error
	List(ctx Context, filters filters.CourseGroupFilters) ([]domain.CourseGroup, error)
}

// CourseGroupI18nRepository describes storage for course group localizations.
type CourseGroupI18nRepository interface {
	Upsert(ctx Context, entry domain.CourseGroupI18n) error
	ListByGroup(ctx Context, groupID string) ([]domain.CourseGroupI18n, error)
	Delete(ctx Context, groupID string, i18nID int) error
}

// TrackLevelRepository describes storage for track-level links.
type TrackLevelRepository interface {
	Add(ctx Context, trackID string, levelID string, order int) error
	Delete(ctx Context, trackID string, levelID string) error
	Replace(ctx Context, trackID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error
}

// LevelCourseGroupRepository describes storage for level-course group links.
type LevelCourseGroupRepository interface {
	Add(ctx Context, levelID string, groupID string, order int) error
	Delete(ctx Context, levelID string, groupID string) error
	Replace(ctx Context, levelID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error
}

// CourseGroupCourseRepository describes storage for course group-course links.
type CourseGroupCourseRepository interface {
	Add(ctx Context, groupID string, courseID string, order int) error
	Delete(ctx Context, groupID string, courseID string) error
	Replace(ctx Context, groupID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error
}

// TransactionManager provides transactional execution.
type TransactionManager interface {
	WithTx(ctx Context, fn func(ctx Context) error) error
}
